architecture_proposed.fit_only_normalization: two purpose-specific mean/standard-deviation transforms, shared across D arms
architecture_proposed.codebook: one shared full-vector 16-dimensional codebook with 1024 centroids; one 10-bit categorical code per recipient
architecture_proposed.code_assignment: minimum squared Euclidean distance, lowest-index tie
architecture_proposed.head: 16 decoded coordinates -> 64 GELU -> purpose class logits
architecture_proposed.vq_fit: Adam 0.001, batch 256, 20 epochs, final iterate; task CE + 0.5 KL(Ucal teacher||head) + 0.25 normalized reconstruction; protected arm adds lambda=1 times mean of exact local1/local2 1024-cell hard-ID one-hot SEX frequency squared differences and a fixed 128-feature factorized Rademacher pair-ID sketch squared difference; hard one-hot forward with temperature-1 distance-softmax straight-through backward to codebook C; frozen h is never updated
architecture_proposed.privacy_objective_random_features: Two seeded independent 1024x128 Rademacher sign tables for aligned pair IDs; local one-hot terms are exact and have no sketch. Pair sketch has a nullspace and requires fresh direct pair-ID attack.
architecture_proposed.assignment_churn_diagnostic: Count fit/inner people whose hard IDs changed from seeded k-means initialization; a decoded-vector move without hard-ID change is a failed protection mechanism check.
architecture_proposed.calibration: one fixed held-out global temperature per task/arm/source seed, no grid

arms_per_source_seed.open_identity: New matched raw joint control is budgeted as one joint encoder/critic training process plus two head refits; S1 must pin actual source/architecture and internal critic update counts before lock.
